Software Engineer (Python, Backend) — Merlion Robotics (fictional)
Singapore, one-north

Merlion Robotics builds fleet-management software for autonomous warehouse robots used by logistics companies in Asia.

What you'll do
- Build and scale backend services in Python (FastAPI) that coordinate hundreds of robots in real time
- Design REST and gRPC APIs consumed by our web dashboard and robots
- Containerise services with Docker and deploy them on Kubernetes (AWS EKS)
- Write tests and take part in code reviews and on-call rotation

What we're looking for
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering
- Solid Python skills and experience building web APIs
- Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD
- Good communication in English

Bonus points
- Kubernetes, gRPC
- Robotics or ROS experience
- Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis

Seniority: Junior to Mid-level
Competitive salary and equity. Visa sponsorship available for the right candidate.
